source: UCI352 Online Retail DOI10.24432/C5BW33 CC BY4.0
unit: source row x declared policy; aggregate by invoice for split and uncertainty, not independent row trials
fairness: Same source documents, policy semantics, data and output schema across execution arms.
Ad hoc arm receives the same natural-language policies but has no persistent separately approved rule artifact.
Separate construction from execution: matched-rule replay holds semantics fixed; end-to-end study includes interpretation errors.
LLM arms share model/version and recorded settings initially. Token/tool/time caps declared before paid calls.
No gold at runtime. Evaluator uses separately frozen references. Never repair model decisions from gold.
scoring: Unknown on reference violation is a missed detection in overall violation recall; never remove it from denominator.
Unknown references excluded from binary precision/recall and separately score unsupported determinate decisions.
Coverage and risk reported jointly; no reward for blanket abstention.
Manual times are explicit assumption ranges, not measured human performance.
Human review queue size is a workload proxy, not observed time saving.
data_governance: First5000 rows already inspected: development only.
Future evaluation excludes every invoice appearing in development and freezes selected invoice groups before tuning.
Official descriptive metadata is not a complete business policy or error gold.
Authored policy fixtures and real-source observations reported separately.
Ragas optional for generated explanations/retrieval; deterministic outcome scoring primary.
